page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword "CAPUT" at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: tibus adhucdum umbras, ἐνισχόμενοι τῷ νόμῳ καὶ τῆς σκιᾶς, (malè in meo Codice ναχι-αις [?]) ut est apud Athanasium, nec dedi-scentibus Ἰουδαΐζειν [?]. Quid ergo mirum, Legis in Evangelio complementum, & respectum illum mutuum, & obversam Legis ad Christum faciem, inductione quâdam, pressis nobilioribus quibusdam typis atque figuris, talibus ostendere Apostolum ac demonstrare? Quemadmodùm idem cum Gentilibus agens, non jam eos ex Veteri Testamento, sed ex propriis illorum principijs, arguit convincitque.

Non ignorari etiam debet, Melchisedecum, ejusque sacerdotium, celebratissimum fuisse inter Judæos, de quo Thalmudistæ varia, imo habitum Messiæ typum, ut in Bereschith Rabba, ad Cap. xiv. Genes. ut Isaac ben Arama, ad Cap. xlvii, Genes. ut Moses Hadarson, ad Cap. xvi. Numer. & si qui plures. Ut nihil mirum in eo urgendo iisdem & declarando, accuratiorem fuisse Apostolum.

page.notes: The Greek words in the first paragraph are only approximately legible at this scan resolution; the accents and the word "ναχιαις" are doubtful. The page number "187" is partly obscured by a blot and may be read differently. The printed hyphens at the line ends were joined where the word continues. The woodcut-free page has no signature.
